items.label: TFC Optical IR activity record: 2026-009 (10-09-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Management (IR record; board secretary and deputy general manager Chen Kairong): the export-control policies

set.signal: Management (IR record; board secretary and deputy general manager Chen Kairong): the related import / export policies published so far place no restrictions on optical device products and do not affect the company's business; its US-market sales share is low, with North America about 1.28% of 2025 revenue. Orders on hand and customer demand remain strong overall, and it will expand capacity globally in line with market demand and customers' project pace. It is optimistic about long-term growth in optical interconnect, especially CPO and NPO.

items.reason: Source speaks of import/export policy restrictions (jin chu kou), not export controls specifically; wording aligned to the answer
items.evidence: Q: recent rumoured overseas import/export policy restrictions; A: the relevant policies published so far place no constraints on optical device products
